intro: PDF to ODT turns a PDF into an OpenDocument text file, the native format of LibreOffice Writer, so you can correct it, extend it or reuse its paragraphs without copying them by hand. ODT is an open, standardised format that also opens in Word, Google Docs and almost any word processor.

There are three modes. Editable uses Docling to recognise headings, paragraphs, lists, tables and images and rebuilds them as flowing text: add a sentence and everything else moves along by itself. Editable with vector graphics as images follows the same path but crops figures at twice the resolution, which helps when the PDF contains drawn diagrams or charts. Faithful layout uses LibreOffice's PDF import: each block sits in a frame in its original position, so the page looks very close to the PDF, although rewriting it takes more effort.

In the editable modes, automatic OCR recognises text in areas that have none, such as scanned pages, before the document is assembled. Under additional options you can pick up to three recognition languages; Spanish is the default, so choose English if that is the language of your file. Use Pages to convert only part of it, for example 1-3, 7 or odd.
The file is processed on our server, with no internet access, and is deleted when your plan's retention period ends: one hour without an account and 24 hours with one.
steps: Choose the mode: Editable to change the text or Faithful layout to keep the original look.

faq.a: If you work with LibreOffice or have been asked for an open format, ODT. If the recipient uses Microsoft Word, PDF to Word gives you a DOCX with the same options.

faq.q: Why is Faithful layout harder to edit?
faq.a: Because every line or block ends up in a frame with a fixed position on the page. Typing more text does not push the rest down as it would in a normal document. Use it when appearance matters more than rewriting.

faq.q: Does it read the text of a scan?
faq.a: Yes in both editable modes, thanks to automatic OCR, which is on by default. Faithful layout imports the PDF as it is and does no OCR: if your PDF is only images, run it through OCR PDF first or pick an editable mode.

faq.q: Can I convert several PDFs at once?
faq.a: Yes. You get one ODT per PDF plus a ZIP containing all of them, so you can download everything in one go.
